hero.title: Next-Gen Web3 Games. Built on Provable Fairness. ⚖️🎮
hero.subtitle: MonkGames designs crash and instant-lotto experiences on open-source, provably fair tech. Engines are free to integrate — the magic (and our revenue) comes from deeply localized, premium themes crafted for specific markets. 🌍✨
hero.badge: Two core philosophies: Open Fairness ⚖️ • Optimized Experience 🎨

cards.title: Provably Fair ⚖️
cards.body: Every round, result, and multiplier is generated by transparent, inspectable logic backed by OpenRNG and web3 proofs.

cards.title: Built for High-Energy Play ⚡
cards.body: Fast-paced crash and instant-lotto formats tuned for modern attention spans, streamers, and communities.

cards.title: Culturally Rooted Worlds 🎭
cards.body: Visual cues, sound design, pacing, and rewards adapted to regional cultures so play feels rare and truly made for that audience.

howItWorks.title: How MonkGames Works 🔧
howItWorks.subtitle: For players, it’s simple. For operators, it’s a powerful way to ship differentiated, market-specific experiences.

steps.title: Pick a Game 🎮
steps.body: Start with our open-source crash or instant-lotto engines and integrate them into your casino or platform.

steps.title: Choose or Commission a Theme 🎨
steps.body: Browse pre-built themes in our marketplace or request a fully custom theme rooted in the culture of your target region.

steps.title: Launch a Unique, Fair Experience 🚀
steps.body: Players enjoy a one-of-one experience with on-chain provable fairness and presentation tailored to their world.

flagship.title: Flagship Experiences 🎮
flagship.subtitle: Our titles are the canvas. The real differentiation comes from the themes and worlds layered on top for specific markets.

games.title: Crossroad Escapables — Crash Game ⚡
games.description: A high-intensity crash experience where players ride the curve, make split-second decisions, and escape before the line breaks. Perfect for streamers and communities chasing high multipliers.
points: Real-time crash multipliers with provable outcomes
Supports multiple visual & audio themes per region
Built for web3 wallets and on-chain verification

games.title: Drawballz | Rushmore Classics — Instant Lotto 🎱
games.description: An instant-lotto universe where classic draw formats meet modern game juice. Designed to be endlessly reskinned into culturally familiar rituals and visual identities.
points: Instant-resolve lotto rounds with clear probabilities
Theme-able tickets, draw rooms, mascots, and soundscapes
Backed by OpenRNG for verifiable draws

marketplace.title: Theme Marketplace & Custom Studio 🎨
marketplace.subtitle: Our game engines are open. We generate revenue by solving a deeper problem: players don’t want the same game, with the same theme, everywhere. They want rare, culturally rooted experiences.

blocks.title: 🛒 Marketplace Themes
blocks.body: Discover pre-built, high-quality themes for Crossroad Escapables and Drawballz. Each theme is tuned to a specific culture, festival, or narrative.
points: Available via fixed price or auction
Localized visuals, sound, UX flow, and copy 🎨🎧

blocks.title: 🎨 Custom, One-of-One Experiences
blocks.body: For enterprise casinos, we craft bespoke themes that reflect the cultural roots of your target players — then assign them to you exclusively.
points: Tailored visuals, sound design, and reward pacing for your region
White-label and proprietary — once delivered, never resold 🔐
Designed for long-term brand equity, not quick skins
